review_candidates.title: Senior Mobile Application Developer
review_candidates.description: Senior Mobile Engineer, Flutter / iOS / Android (6 openings) Develop, enhance, test and maintain consumer mobile apps. Each engineer must be expert in at least one of Flutter, Swift or Kotlin and productive in a second. State your primary and secondary technology in your application. Requirements 10+ years software engineering. 5+ years mobile. Shipped apps in production on the App Store and Google Play. REST API integration, secure coding, automated tests, Git and CI/CD. Payments or banking app experience preferred. Fluent English. About the engagement Datalake is building dedicated engineering squads for a leading financial services company in Riyadh. You will work from a Datalake delivery centre in Riyadh, Cairo or Tunis (no home working), Sunday to Thursday, 9:00 to 17:00 Saudi time (UTC+3), on the Saudi public holiday calendar, inside the client's SDLC, repositories and CI/CD. Squads share a 24/7 critical incident on call rota with a documented backup. Professional English is mandatory for all documentation, ceremonies and reporting. Arabic is a plus. How to apply Apply on the Datalake careers page (datalake.sa/careers) and select this role. Your application must state: (1) the city you will work from (Riyadh, Cairo or Tunis), (2) expected monthly salary and currency, (3) total years of professional experience, (4) notice period, (5) your primary and secondary mobile technology. Applications without these items are not reviewed. Datalake processes candidate data under Saudi PDPL in me central2 (Dammam). ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27701 certified organisation.

review_candidates.title: Frontend Developer
review_candidates.description: About Our Company : We are a technology-driven company that develops robust, scalable, and efficient business applications, particularly in the ERP domain, with a strong focus on HR/Payroll and accounting functionality. Our solutions are built on established e-commerce platforms, adapted and extended to meet complex enterprise requirements. We are committed to continuous improvement and adherence to software development best practices. The Role: We are seeking a talented and experienced Frontend Developer to enhance the user experience and interface of our enterprise resource planning system. You will implement and maintain the client-side of our web application, ensuring responsiveness, usability, and visual appeal. This role requires a strong understanding of modern web technologies, particularly Kendo UI, and experience working within an ASP.NET MVC environment. Key Responsibilities: •Develop and maintain responsive and intuitive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. •Implement and customize Kendo UI components to meet design and functionality requirements. •Work extensively with Razor views ( .cshtml ) to integrate frontend logic with backend data. •Collaborate closely with backend developers to consume APIs and ensure seamless data flow. •Ensure cross-browser compatibility and optimal performance of the web application. •Address UI/UX feedback and implement improvements to enhance user satisfaction. •Participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality and consistency. •Troubleshoot and debug frontend issues, providing effective and timely solutions. •Adhere to project-specific coding conventions, including detailed commenting and change logging. •Manage client-side assets and dependencies, including npm install for project-specific packages. Required Skills & Experience: •Proven experience as a Frontend Developer with a strong portfolio of web applications. •Expertise in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+). •Extensive experience with Kendo UI (version 2022.3.1109 or later) and its integration into web projects. •Proficiency in ASP.NET MVC and Razor views ( .cshtml ). • Familiarity with client-side asset management (e.g., bundleconfig.json , libman.json ).
